completion_truth: PROSE is the only complete system. SYSTEM_MASTER, CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS are incomplete and active.
startup_sequence: Read this file from current main.
Read program_job_lock and system_completion_status before making any completion claim or selecting work.
Read SYSTEM-TOPOLOGY-004.json. Active peers are CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS; PROSE is the completed active Book child specialist and has no independent peer/Second Shift lane.
Fetch the relevant live owner control head; never use a stale snapshot as current authority.
Read the authority-selected obligation_registry and expectation_registry before choosing work.
SYSTEM_MASTER product-root job is integration of CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS; Core administers the shared integration infrastructure without taking peer-system semantics.

BOOK job is to finish Book, including bringing the completed PROSE child into Book through adapters and the Book Workflow Orchestrator, then integrate Book upward into System Master. BOOK remains sole canonical manuscript/Story Bible/author/lifecycle/admission owner.

PROSE is already complete. Do not restart Prose as a new system or expand its feature scope absent demonstrated defect or explicit user direction. Active integration work around Prose executes through BOOK.
LEARNING job is to finish Learning and integrate it upward into System Master; do not cross into Book/Prose/Documents product work.
DOCUMENTS job is to finish Documents and integrate it upward into System Master; do not absorb Prose or take Book-specific literary authority.
Knowledge Recovery is supporting Core-administered custody/provenance work, not the central product priority and not a peer system.
Second Shift active peer lanes remain CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS. Enforce one mutation-capable claim per lane and reject cross-lane job drift.
Before ending substantive work, re-read the live head, reconcile owner delegation/current objective, and leave one exact dependency-valid successor.

truth_classes.AUTHORITY_CURRENT: Live owner state, current job lock, completion status and evidence agree.
truth_classes.AUTHORITY_DELTA: Live owner state moved after the current selector; reconcile only the delta.
truth_classes.JOB_LANE_VIOLATION: Work attempts to take another active system's product job or semantic authority outside an explicitly admitted interface.
truth_classes.FALSE_SYSTEM_COMPLETION: A phase, packet, test, branch or subsystem closure is being used to claim completion of SYSTEM_MASTER, CORE, LEARNING, BOOK or DOCUMENTS.
truth_classes.PROSE_SCOPE_REOPEN: Work attempts to restart or expand completed Prose semantics without a demonstrated defect or explicit user direction.
truth_classes.STALE_DELEGATION: Second Shift delegation does not match the live owner head, current obligation, or current program job lock.
truth_classes.EVIDENCE_MISMATCH: Claimed standing exceeds exact subject/receipt/artifact evidence.
truth_classes.HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED: Machine-readable authority cannot select among valid product choices.
truth_classes.AUTHOR_DECISION_REQUIRED: Progress requires author authority automation cannot synthesize.
truth_classes.PRIVATE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Progress requires private data authority not currently granted.
truth_classes.NATIVE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Progress requires native device/platform evidence not currently available.
truth_classes.EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Progress requires external provider/publication/certification authority not granted by repository evidence.

write_rules: Historical evidence and exact-SHA receipts remain append-only.
Only PROSE may currently be described as a complete system.
BOOK <-> PROSE is the only direct specialist parent/child integration exception; Prose execution inherits BOOK lane control.
CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS remain in their own product lanes and integrate upward through System Master/shared interfaces without ownership transfer.
Documents may provide document/artifact services to Book but may not absorb Prose or mutate Book canonical state.
Knowledge Recovery remains supporting work and may not redefine system jobs or block independent Book/Learning/Documents progress.
Changed integration bytes require fresh evidence; no PASS transfers across changed SHA/subject/ownership boundaries.
